mapper.select:
select sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Code as secCode, sec.Sec_Type as secType, sec.Sec_Organize_Form as secOrganizeForm, sec.Sec_Bidding_Type as secBiddingType, sec.Sec_Start_Time as secStartTime, sec.Sec_Bidding_Cycle as secBiddingCycle, sec.Sec_Place as secPlace, sec.Sec_Contracting_department as secContractingDepartment, dp.D_Name as secContractingDepartmentName, c4.C_Name as tendereeName, c6.C_Name as secAgencyName, c4.C_Abbreviation as tendereeAbbName, sd.D_Amount as dAmount, pre.p_Name as pName,
aq.*, CASE WHEN sec.Sec_Bidding_Type = '05' THEN (SELECT sir.Sir_Plan_Open_Place FROM Sec_Inquiry_Record sir WHERE sir.Sec_Id = aq.Sec_Id AND sir.P_Id = aq.P_Id AND sir.State = 7 ORDER BY sir.Create_Time DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN sec.Sec_Bidding_Type = '07' THEN (SELECT sbn.Bn_Plan_Open_Location FROM Sec_Bidding_Negotiation sbn WHERE sbn.Sec_Id = aq.Sec_Id AND sbn.P_Id = aq.P_Id AND sbn.State = 7 ORDER BY sbn.Create_Time DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE (SELECT sd2.D_Location FROM Sec_Document sd2 WHERE sd2.Sec_Id = aq.Sec_Id AND sd2.P_Id = aq.P_Id AND sd2.D_State = 7 ORDER BY sd2.D_Create_Time DESC LIMIT 1) END as aqPlanOpenLocation, CASE WHEN sec.Sec_Bidding_Type = '05' THEN (SELECT sir.Sir_Plan_Open_Time FROM Sec_Inquiry_Record sir WHERE sir.Sec_Id = aq.Sec_Id AND sir.P_Id = aq.P_Id AND sir.State = 7 ORDER BY sir.Create_Time DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN sec.Sec_Bidding_Type = '07' THEN (SELECT sbn.Bn_Plan_Open_Time FROM Sec_Bidding_Negotiation sbn WHERE sbn.Sec_Id = aq.Sec_Id AND sbn.P_Id = aq.P_Id AND sbn.State = 7 ORDER BY sbn.Create_Time DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE (SELECT sd2.D_Bid_Time FROM Sec_Document sd2 WHERE sd2.Sec_Id = aq.Sec_Id AND sd2.P_Id = aq.P_Id AND sd2.D_State = 7 ORDER BY sd2.D_Create_Time DESC LIMIT 1) END as aqPlanOpenTime, sf.file_relation_id as fileRelationId from Sec_Answer_Question aq left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=aq.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c4 on c4.C_ID=sec.Sec_Tenderee left join Sys_Company c6 on c6.C_Id=sec.Sec_Agency left join Sys_Department dp on dp.D_Id=sec.Sec_Contracting_department left join Sec_Document sd on aq.Sec_Id=sd.Sec_Id and sd.D_State=7 left join pre_project pre on pre.p_id=aq.p_id left join Sys_file sf on sf.FileId=aq.aq_Id where aq.Aq_Id=#{aqId} order by sd.D_Create_Time desc limit 1

sql.if: and (case when aq.P_Id is null then sp.P_Id else aq.P_Id end) = #{params.pId}

choose.when: and ( (case when pre.P_Name is null then sp.P_Name else pre.P_Name end) is null or (case when pre.P_Name is null then sp.P_Name else pre.P_Name end) = '' )
choose.otherwise:
and (case when pre.P_Name is null then sp.P_Name else pre.P_Name end) in
#{pName}

choose.when: and ( (case when pre.P_Category is null then sp.p_Category else pre.P_Category end) is null or (case when pre.P_Category is null then sp.p_Category else pre.P_Category end) = '' )
choose.otherwise:
and (case when pre.P_Category is null then sp.p_Category else pre.P_Category end) in
#{pCategory}

mapper.select: select ${selectClause} from Sec_Answer_Question mn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id left join pre_project pre on pre.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Department dpre on dpre.D_Id = pre.p_Competent_Department left join Sec_Bidding_Plan sbp on sbp.Bp_Id=sec.Bp_Id left join ( select sp1.Sec_Id, sp1.P_ID, pro1.P_Name, pro1.p_Category, pro1.P_Build_Model, dpre1.D_Name from Sec_Project sp1 inner join pre_project pro1 on pro1.P_Id = sp1.P_Id left join SYS_Department dpre1 on dpre1.D_Id = pro1.p_Competent_Department where not exists ( select 1 from Sec_Project sp2 inner join pre_project pro2 on pro2.P_Id = sp2.P_Id where sp2.Sec_Id = sp1.Sec_Id and pro2.P_Create_Time > pro1.P_Create_Time )) sp on sp.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id ${authSql}

select count(1) from Sec_Answer_Question mn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id left join pre_project pre on pre.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Department dpre on dpre.D_Id = pre.p_Competent_Department left join Sec_Bidding_Plan sbp on sbp.Bp_Id=sec.Bp_Id left join ( select sp1.Sec_Id, sp1.P_ID, pro1.P_Name, pro1.p_Category, pro1.P_Build_Model, dpre1.D_Name from Sec_Project sp1 inner join pre_project pro1 on pro1.P_Id = sp1.P_Id left join SYS_Department dpre1 on dpre1.D_Id = pro1.p_Competent_Department where not exists ( select 1 from Sec_Project sp2 inner join pre_project pro2 on pro2.P_Id = sp2.P_Id where sp2.Sec_Id = sp1.Sec_Id and pro2.P_Create_Time > pro1.P_Create_Time )) sp on sp.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id ${authSql}

select count(1) from Sec_Answer_Question aq left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=aq.Sec_Id left join ( select sp1.Sec_Id, sp1.P_ID, pro1.P_Name, pro1.p_Category, pro1.P_Build_Model, dpre1.D_Name from Sec_Project sp1 inner join pre_project pro1 on pro1.P_Id = sp1.P_Id left join SYS_Department dpre1 on dpre1.D_Id = pro1.p_Competent_Department where not exists ( select 1 from Sec_Project sp2 inner join pre_project pro2 on pro2.P_Id = sp2.P_Id where sp2.Sec_Id = sp1.Sec_Id and pro2.P_Create_Time > pro1.P_Create_Time )) sp on sp.Sec_Id = aq.Sec_Id ${params.authSql}

select count(1) from Sec_Answer_Question aq left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=aq.Sec_Id left join ( select sp1.Sec_Id, sp1.P_ID, pro1.P_Name, pro1.p_Category, pro1.P_Build_Model, dpre1.D_Name from Sec_Project sp1 inner join pre_project pro1 on pro1.P_Id = sp1.P_Id left join SYS_Department dpre1 on dpre1.D_Id = pro1.p_Competent_Department where not exists ( select 1 from Sec_Project sp2 inner join pre_project pro2 on pro2.P_Id = sp2.P_Id where sp2.Sec_Id = sp1.Sec_Id and pro2.P_Create_Time > pro1.P_Create_Time )) sp on sp.Sec_Id = aq.Sec_Id ${params.authSql}
mapper.sql: ( select sd.D_Name from Pre_Project pro left join Sec_Project sp on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id left join Sys_Department sd on sd.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department where sd.D_Name is not null and sp.Sec_Id=aq.Sec_Id limit 1 ) as pCompetentDepartmentName,

(select wm_concat(P_Id) from Sec_Project where Sec_Id=aq.Sec_Id) as pId, (select wm_concat(pro.P_Name) from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=aq.Sec_Id) as pName,

sql.if: and (select wm_concat(pro.P_Name) from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=aq.Sec_Id) like concat('%',#{params.pName},'%')

mapper.sql: (select string_agg(P_Id,',') from Sec_Project where Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id) as pId, (select string_agg(pro.P_Name,',') from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id) as pName,

sql.if: and (select string_agg(pro.P_Name,',') from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id) like concat('%',#{params.pName},'%')

mapper.sql: (select GROUP_CONCAT(P_Id) from Sec_Project where Sec_Id=aq.Sec_Id) as pId, (select GROUP_CONCAT(pro.P_Name) from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=aq.Sec_Id) as pName,

sql.if: and (select GROUP_CONCAT(pro.P_Name) from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=aq.Sec_Id) like concat('%',#{params.pName},'%')
